# Tessaroot API documentation

The Tessaroot API gives growers programmatic access to the readings of every sensor their
greenhouse gateways report: air temperature, relative humidity, CO2, light and soil
moisture. The current version is 2; version 1 stops answering on 31 January 2027.

## Guides

- Authentication: https://docs.tessaroot.example/v2/authentication
- Errors: https://docs.tessaroot.example/v2/errors
- SDKs and tools: https://docs.tessaroot.example/sdks

## Reference (v2)

- Sensor readings: https://docs.tessaroot.example/v2/reference/readings

## Troubleshooting (v2)

- TSR-4011, the token has expired: https://docs.tessaroot.example/v2/troubleshooting/tsr-4011
- TSR-7702, the sensor was retired: https://docs.tessaroot.example/v2/troubleshooting/tsr-7702
- TSR-7719, the range is held: https://docs.tessaroot.example/v2/troubleshooting/tsr-7719

## Legacy

- Version 1 gateway backfill guide: https://docs.tessaroot.example/v1/guides/gateway-backfill

The API's base URL is `https://api.tessaroot.example`.
